## Objective

Nothing enters unclassified or above what is admitted.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unclassified input is held at K2
- [ ] K3 is refused without a clearance record
- [ ] K4 and secret-like content are refused
- [ ] limits on size and type hold
- [ ] Instruction-bearing and configuration files are refused at intake

## Test requirements

Unit and integration tests with hostile fixtures.

## Deliverables

Code or configuration, tests, and updated documentation for this ticket.

Deployment tickets distinguish code complete, tested, deployment ready, deployed and production verified.
